title: Dry Saturday, wet Friday: one evening outside, the rest under a roof.
subtitle: Friday turns to showers after six, so Friday stays indoors. Saturday and Sunday are dry and mild. Nothing is booked yet, and Sam's birthday is five weeks out, so the book-ahead list starts watching for it.
alert: The lantern walk's last weekend is May 29-31. If this weekend doesn't work, that's the final chance this year.

context.label: Sunday
context.value: 26 °C, clear. The best day of the three

options.title: Night lantern walk at the botanical garden
options.hook: Two hundred paper lanterns strung through the gardens after dark, and one of the last two weekends before it's packed away for the year.

fields.v: Saturday: arrive 7:30pm, so you see it in dusk and in full dark. Runs to 10pm

fields.html: Timed tickets. Pick the 7:30 slot; the 8pm queue is the long one

fields.v: Your best-date answers were both evening walks, and this is the first dry Saturday in three weeks.
The dumpling bar at the garden gate stays open until 11.

options.title: Salsa for beginners, Friday drop-in
options.hook: An hour of basic steps with no partner-swapping and no experience needed. Then the floor opens up and you can stay as long as you like.

fields.v: Friday, class 8-9pm, social dancing until midnight

fields.html: Walk in. The dance studio by the station (checked their schedule this morning)

fields.v: $18 per person, cash or card at the door
You both put 'doing over watching' at setup, and nothing hands-on has made it onto a weekend yet.
Same class runs Thursdays if Friday fills up.

options.title: Trivia at the corner pub
options.hook: The cheap, easy one. Nothing to book, ten minutes' walk, and you came second last time.

fields.v: Just turn up. Tables go by 5:45
Free to play. Food and drinks around $20 per person
Back to a known favorite: your April note said 'we need a rematch'.

options.title: Rooftop tapas, back to the terrace
options.hook: The clearest evening of the weekend, on the terrace you liked in March, while the long light lasts.

fields.v: Sunday, 7:30pm table, so you catch the 8:09 sunset

fields.html: Reserve on their site. Terrace tables book up by Friday. Phone as a backup: (555) 010-0142

fields.v: About $55 per person with a drink each
The patatas bravas and the grilled halloumi are both shellfish-free; ask them to keep the romesco separate.
Your one 'loved it' dinner this spring. It's been two months.

bookAhead.html: Jazz festival weekend passes go on sale Tue May 20 at 10am, $65 per person. Last year they were gone by Thursday. The trio you both named at setup is on the Saturday bill.
Sam's birthday (June 20): the chef's counter at the waterfront restaurant books exactly 30 days out, which means a May 21 booking.

footnote: Built Wed May 14. No notes came in for last weekend, so the two votes for the market were read as 'liked but not done'. Tell me if you went. Verified this morning: the lantern walk dates and price on the garden's own page, the studio's Friday class on their schedule, and the jazz festival on-sale on the festival's site. The ticketing connector was down, so the festival was checked by hand. Weather from the national forecast, issued 5am. Question for you: is a Friday class still realistic now that work runs late on Fridays?
